035
036public class CalculateSquareAttributes {
037
038    /**
039     * Fraction of a recording's squares (those with the lowest track counts) used
040     * to estimate the background track density for the "original" density ratio
041     * ({@code Density Ratio Ori}). This is a fixed methodological constant of the
042     * original Python method, not a user-tunable parameter; it is kept explicit
043     * here rather than as a magic literal.
044     */
045    private static final double BACKGROUND_SQUARES_FRACTION = 0.1;
046
047    /**
048     * Calculates attributes for every square in a recording, including Tau,
049     * density, variability, density ratio, and various kinematic statistics.
050     * Visibility filtering is performed based on configuration parameters,
051     * followed by label number assignment for visible squares.
052     *
053     * @param experimentPath        the experiment path (used for plot output)
054     * @param recording             the recording containing track and square data
055     * @param generateSquaresConfig configuration parameters for the calculation
056     */
057    public static void calculateSquareAttributes(Path experimentPath,
058            Recording recording,
059            GenerateSquaresConfig generateSquaresConfig) {
060        double                     minRequiredRSquared              = generateSquaresConfig.getMinRequiredRSquared();
061        int                        minNumberOfTracksToCalculate     = generateSquaresConfig.getMinTracksToCalculate();
062        int                        minNumberOfTracksToCalculateTau  = generateSquaresConfig.getMinTracksToCalculateTau();
063        double                     maxAllowableVariability          = generateSquaresConfig.getMaxAllowableVariability();
064        double                     minRequiredDensityRatio          = generateSquaresConfig.getMinRequiredDensityRatio();
065        String                     neighbourMode                    = generateSquaresConfig.getNeighbourMode();
066        int                        numberOfSquaresInRecording       = generateSquaresConfig.getNumberOfSquaresInRecording();
067        double                     squareArea                       = calculateSquareArea(numberOfSquaresInRecording);    // Here we look at the single square
068        double                     concentration                    = recording.getConcentration();
069        List<Square>               squaresOfRecording               = recording.getSquaresOfRecording();
070        boolean                    showTauFittingPlots              = generateSquaresConfig.isTauFittingPlots();
071        BackgroundEstimationResult bgResult                         = calculateBackgroundDensity(squaresOfRecording);
072        CalcParams                 params                           = new CalcParams(recording, generateSquaresConfig, bgResult);
073
074        PaintLogger.debugf("Estimated Background track count = %.2f, number of background squares = %d%n",
075                           params.numberOfTracksInBackgroundSquare, bgResult.getNumberOfBackgroundSquares());
076
077        for (Square square : squaresOfRecording) {
078            calculateAttributesForSquare(square, experimentPath, recording, generateSquaresConfig, params);
079        }
080
081        // --- Apply visibility filters ---
082        applyVisibilityFilter(squaresOfRecording,
083                              params.minRequiredDensityRatio,
084                              params.maxAllowableVariability,
085                              params.minRequiredRSquared,
086                              params.neighbourMode);
087
088        // --- Assign label numbers to visible squares ---
089        int labelNumber = 0;
090        for (Square sq : squaresOfRecording) {
091            if (sq.isVisible()) {
092                sq.setLabelNumber(labelNumber++);
093            }
094        }
095    }
096
097    /**
098     * Container for calculation parameters to reduce argument counts.
099     */
100    private static class CalcParams {
101        final double  minRequiredRSquared;
102        final int     minNumberOfTracksToCalculate;
103        final int     minNumberOfTracksToCalculateTau;
104        final double  maxAllowableVariability;
105        final double  minRequiredDensityRatio;
106        final String  neighbourMode;
107        final int     numberOfSquaresInRecording;
108        final double  squareArea;
109        final double  concentration;
110        final boolean showTauFittingPlots;
111        final double  numberOfTracksInBackgroundSquare;
112        final double  backgroundTracksOri;
113
114        CalcParams(Recording recording, GenerateSquaresConfig config, BackgroundEstimationResult bgResult) {
115            this.minRequiredRSquared              = config.getMinRequiredRSquared();
116            this.minNumberOfTracksToCalculate     = config.getMinTracksToCalculate();
117            this.minNumberOfTracksToCalculateTau  = config.getMinTracksToCalculateTau();
118            this.maxAllowableVariability          = config.getMaxAllowableVariability();
119            this.minRequiredDensityRatio          = config.getMinRequiredDensityRatio();
120            this.neighbourMode                    = config.getNeighbourMode();
121            this.numberOfSquaresInRecording       = config.getNumberOfSquaresInRecording();
122            this.squareArea                       = calculateSquareArea(numberOfSquaresInRecording);
123            this.concentration                    = recording.getConcentration();
124            this.showTauFittingPlots              = config.isTauFittingPlots();
125            this.numberOfTracksInBackgroundSquare = bgResult.getNumberOfTracksInBackgroundSquare();
126            this.backgroundTracksOri              = calcAverageTrackCountInBackgroundSquares(recording.getSquaresOfRecording(),
127                                                                                            (int) (BACKGROUND_SQUARES_FRACTION * numberOfSquaresInRecording));
128        }
129    }
130
131    private static void calculateAttributesForSquare(Square square, Path experimentPath, Recording recording,
132                                                     GenerateSquaresConfig config, CalcParams params) {
133
134        List<Track> tracksInSquare = square.getTracks();
135        if (tracksInSquare == null || tracksInSquare.isEmpty()) {
136            return;
137        }
138
139        Table table = square.getTracksTable();
140        if (table.rowCount() == 0) {
141            return;
142        }
143
144        // Do not calculate attributes if not enough tracks
145        if (tracksInSquare.size() < params.minNumberOfTracksToCalculate) {
146            square.resetCalculatedAttributes();
147            return;
148        }
149
150        int squareNumber = square.getSquareNumber();
151
152        // --- Tau fitting ---
153        if (tracksInSquare.size() >= params.minNumberOfTracksToCalculateTau) {
154            CalculateTau.CalculateTauResult results = calculateTau(tracksInSquare, params.minRequiredRSquared);
155
156            if (params.showTauFittingPlots) {
157                saveTauFitPlot(tracksInSquare, results, experimentPath,
158                               recording.getRecordingName(), squareNumber);
159            }
160
161            if (results.getStatus() == CalculateTau.CalculateTauResult.Status.TAU_SUCCESS) {
162                square.setTau(round(results.getTau(), 0));
163                square.setRSquared(round(results.getRSquared(), 3));
164            } else {
165                square.setTau(Double.NaN);
166                square.setRSquared(Double.NaN);
167            }
168        } else {
169            square.setTau(Double.NaN);
170            square.setRSquared(Double.NaN);
171        }
172
173        // --- Variability, density, kinematic metrics ---
174
175        // Note that double values are written with 3 decimals in Squares
176
177        final int PRECISION_L  = 2;
178        final int PRECISION_M1 = 3;
179        final int PRECISION_M2 = 4;
180        final int PRECISION_H  = 5;
181
182        square.setVariability(round(calculateVariability(table, squareNumber, params.numberOfSquaresInRecording, 10),       PRECISION_M1));
183        square.setDensity(round(calculateDensity(tracksInSquare.size(), params.squareArea, RECORDING_DURATION, params.concentration), PRECISION_H));
184        square.setDensityRatio(round(calculateDensityRatio(tracksInSquare.size(), params.numberOfTracksInBackgroundSquare),           PRECISION_M1));
185        square.setDensityRatioOri(round(calculateDensityRatio(tracksInSquare.size(), params.backgroundTracksOri),                     PRECISION_M1));
186
187        square.setMedianDiffusionCoefficient(round(table.doubleColumn(DIFFUSION_COEFFICIENT).median(),        PRECISION_M2));
188        square.setMedianDiffusionCoefficientExt(round(table.doubleColumn(DIFFUSION_COEFFICIENT_EXT).median(), PRECISION_M1));
189
190        square.setMedianDisplacement(round(table.doubleColumn(TRACK_DISPLACEMENT).median(), PRECISION_L));
191        square.setMaxDisplacement(round(table.doubleColumn(TRACK_DISPLACEMENT).max(),       PRECISION_L));
192        square.setTotalDisplacement(round(table.doubleColumn(TRACK_DISPLACEMENT).sum(),     PRECISION_L));
193
194        square.setMedianMaxSpeed(round(table.doubleColumn(TRACK_MAX_SPEED).median(),        PRECISION_L));
195        square.setMaxMaxSpeed(round(table.doubleColumn(TRACK_MAX_SPEED).max(),              PRECISION_L));
196
197        square.setMedianMedianSpeed(round(table.doubleColumn(TRACK_MEDIAN_SPEED).median(),  PRECISION_L));
198        square.setMaxMedianSpeed(round(table.doubleColumn(TRACK_MEDIAN_SPEED).max(),        PRECISION_L));
199
200        square.setMaxTrackDuration(round(table.doubleColumn(TRACK_DURATION).max(),          PRECISION_L));
201        square.setTotalTrackDuration(round(table.doubleColumn(TRACK_DURATION).sum(),        PRECISION_L));
202        square.setMedianTrackDuration(round(table.doubleColumn(TRACK_DURATION).median(),    PRECISION_L));
203    }
204
205    /**
206     * Computes recording-level attributes, including Tau, R², background statistics,
207     * and density estimates based on selected (visible) squares.
208     *
209     * @param recording             the recording being processed
210     * @param generateSquaresConfig configuration parameters
211     */
212    public static void calculateRecordingAttributes(Recording recording,
213            GenerateSquaresConfig generateSquaresConfig) {
214
215        double minRequiredRSquared = generateSquaresConfig.getMinRequiredRSquared();
216
217        List<Square>               squaresOfRecording   = recording.getSquaresOfRecording();
218        BackgroundEstimationResult bgResult             = calculateBackgroundDensity(squaresOfRecording);
219        double                     meanBackgroundTracks = bgResult.getNumberOfTracksInBackgroundSquare();
220        int                        backgroundTracks     = bgResult.getBackgroundSquares()
221                                                                  .stream()
222                                                                  .mapToInt(Square::getNumberOfTracks)
223                                                                  .sum();
224
225        recording.setNumberOfSquaresInBackground(bgResult.getBackgroundSquares().size());
226        recording.setNumberOfTracksInBackground(backgroundTracks);
227        recording.setAverageTracksInBackGround(round(meanBackgroundTracks, 3));
228
229        List<Track> selectedTracks = getTracksFromSelectedSquares(squaresOfRecording);
230
231        if (selectedTracks.isEmpty()) {
232            recording.setTau(Double.NaN);
233            recording.setRSquared(Double.NaN);
234            recording.setDensity(0.0);
235            return;
236        }
237
238        // --- Tau for the whole recording ---
239        CalculateTau.CalculateTauResult tauResult = calculateTau(selectedTracks, minRequiredRSquared);
240
241        if (tauResult.getStatus() == CalculateTau.CalculateTauResult.Status.TAU_SUCCESS) {
242            recording.setTau(round(tauResult.getTau(), 0));
243            recording.setRSquared(round(tauResult.getRSquared(), 3));
244        } else {
245            recording.setTau(Double.NaN);
246            recording.setRSquared(Double.NaN);
247        }
248
249        // --- Recording density metrics ---
250        int totalTracks = selectedTracks.size();
251
252        int    nSelectedSquares = getNumberOfSelectedSquares(recording);
253        double area             = calculateSquareArea(generateSquaresConfig.getNumberOfSquaresInRecording()) * nSelectedSquares;
254        double concentration    = recording.getConcentration();
255
256        recording.setDensity(round(calculateDensity(totalTracks, area, RECORDING_DURATION, concentration), 3));
257    }
258
259    /**
260     * Returns the density ratio between a square and the background track density.
261     */
262    public static double calculateDensityRatio(int numberOfTracksInSquare,
263            double numberOfTracksInBackgroundSquare) {
264        return (numberOfTracksInBackgroundSquare == 0)
265                ? 0
266                : numberOfTracksInSquare / numberOfTracksInBackgroundSquare;
267    }
268
269    /**
270     * Computes spatial variability of track positions within a square.
271     * Variability is defined as the coefficient of variation (σ / μ) over
272     * grid-cell track counts within a `granularity × granularity` subdivision
273     * of the square.
274     */
275    public static double calculateVariability(Table tracks,
276            int squareNumber,
277            int numberOfSquaresInRecording,
278            int granularity) {
279
280        int[][] matrix    = new int[granularity][granularity];
281        int     dimension = GenerateSquaresConfig.gridSizeFor(numberOfSquaresInRecording);
282        double  width     = IMAGE_WIDTH  / dimension;
283        double  height    = IMAGE_HEIGHT / dimension;   // was IMAGE_WIDTH: harmless only while the image is square
284
285        // Access the columns once
286        DoubleColumn xCol = tracks.doubleColumn(TRACK_X_LOCATION);
287        DoubleColumn yCol = tracks.doubleColumn(TRACK_Y_LOCATION);
288
289        for (int i = 0; i < tracks.rowCount(); i++) {
290            double x = xCol.get(i);  // The x-coordinate of the track
291            double y = yCol.get(i);  // The y-coordinate of the track
292
293            int[] indices = getIndices(x, y, width, height, squareNumber, dimension, granularity);
294            int   xi      = indices[0];
295            int   yi      = indices[1];
296
297            if (xi >= 0 && xi < granularity && yi >= 0 && yi < granularity) {
298                matrix[yi][xi]++;
299            }
300        }
301
302        // Flatten matrix into an 1D array for stats
303        int totalCells = granularity * granularity;
304        double[] values = new double[totalCells];
305
306        int idx = 0;
307        for (int r = 0; r < granularity; r++) {
308            for (int c = 0; c < granularity; c++) {
309                values[idx++] = matrix[r][c];
310            }
311        }
312
313        double mean = mean(values);
314        if (mean == 0) {
315            return 0.0;
316        }
317
318        double std = std(values, mean);
319        return std / mean;
320    }
321
322    /**
323     * Computes the mean of an array of doubles.
324     */
325    private static double mean(double[] values) {
326        double sum = 0.0;
327        for (double value : values) {
328            sum += value;
329        }
330        return sum / values.length;
331    }
332
333    /**
334     * Computes the population standard deviation of an array of doubles.
335     */
336    private static double std(double[] values, double mean) {
337        double sumSq = 0.0;
338        for (double value : values) {
339            double diff = value - mean;
340            sumSq += diff * diff;
341        }
342        return Math.sqrt(sumSq / values.length);
343    }
344
345    /**
346     * Calculates the grid indices for a point within a specific square of a recording.
347     * The method determines the location of the point in a finer grid inside the square,
348     * based on the specified granularity.
349     *
350     * @param x1                   the x-coordinate of the point in the global coordinate system
351     * @param y1                   the y-coordinate of the point in the global coordinate system
352     * @param width                the width of each square in the grid
353     * @param height               the height of each square in the grid
354     * @param squareSequenceNumber the sequence number of the square in the grid
355     * @param numberOfSquaresInRow the total number of squares in a single row of the grid
356     * @param granularity          the number of subdivisions along one axis within a square
357     * @return an array of two integers, where the first value is the x-index (column index)
358     * and the second value is the y-index (row index) of the point in the finer grid
359     */
360    private static int[] getIndices(double x1,
361            double y1,
362            double width,
363            double height,
364            int    squareSequenceNumber,
365            int    numberOfSquaresInRow,
366            int    granularity) {
367
368        double x0 = (squareSequenceNumber % numberOfSquaresInRow) * width;
369        double y0 = (squareSequenceNumber / numberOfSquaresInRow) * height;     // Integer division is intended
370
371        int xi = (int) (((x1 - x0) / width)  * granularity);
372        int yi = (int) (((y1 - y0) / height) * granularity);
373
374        return new int[]{xi, yi};
375    }
376}
